task.title: Connect power
task.shortdesc: Wire the station to the site supply through the supplied adapter.

prereq.p: The mast is mounted and the cable gland is in place.

step.cmd: Run the supply cable through the gland.
Terminate the pair in the adapter block.
Switch the site supply on and read the status LED.

info.p: See the wiring diagram below for the terminal order.

image.alt: Terminal block with the supply pair on terminals one and two
